_readme: Farm visit listings shown on /farm-visits/. Edit this file to add or change a farm. booking_mode 'whatsapp' routes every booking button to WhatsApp; 'form' uses the booking form instead.

policy.refund_note: Free reschedule up to 72 hours before the visit. Full refund if the host cancels or the visit is rained off. 50% refund between 24 and 72 hours. No refund under 24 hours.

experiences.title: SARVAANI Farm: Bees, Medicinal Plants & Coffee
experiences.duration: Half day or full day, by arrangement
experiences.summary: Five hands-on modules on one working farm — a medicinal plant walk, a beekeeping workshop covering native stingless bees, vermicompost and biogas, livestock care, and a walk through the coffee estate. Hosted by Kantharaju and his family, with home-cooked meals and estate coffee.
includes: Five guided modules (pick the ones you need)
Freshly plucked farm fruit — star fruit, guava, papaya
Estate coffee on arrival and departure
experiences.best_months: Ask us — the coffee and honey calendars run at different times

modules.title: Medicinal & Herbal Plants Walk
modules.overview: A guided sensory tour of the farm's medicinal plant life.
modules.learn: Identification, taste and human health uses of native medicinal leaves — Kaama Kasturi (sweet basil), lemon grass, Navrangi, mint and Kirataka.
modules.takeaway: How to use backyard plants as natural remedies for everyday health.

modules.title: Apiculture (Beekeeping) Workshop
modules.overview: A deep dive into the life cycle of bees and their ecological role.
modules.learn: Colony hierarchy and the roles inside a hive, with a special focus on native varieties including the stingless Mujanti bee and its life cycle.

modules.title: Sustainable Energy & Composting
modules.overview: Circular farming and waste management as actually practised here.
modules.learn: The role of Erehula (earthworms) in building rich compost, and step-by-step guidance on building and running a gobar gas (biogas) plant — including the safety precautions.

modules.title: Livestock & Animal Husbandry
modules.learn: Care requirements across the farm's livestock — the different cows, sheep and goats, and how they fit the rest of the system.

modules.title: Coffee Cultivation Tour
modules.overview: A backend look at what it takes to produce a good cup.
modules.learn: A walking tour of the coffee estate covering planting, cultivation and crop care through the season.

amenities: Hosted by Kantharaju and his family
Farm-to-table meals — local pulao, rice and sambar
experiences.language_note: All sessions are conducted in Kannada.
experiences.title_kn: ಸರ್ವಾಣಿ ತೋಟ: ಜೇನು, ಔಷಧೀಯ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಫಿ
experiences.summary_kn: ಒಂದೇ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಐದು ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ತರಬೇತಿ ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್‌ಗಳು — ಔಷಧೀಯ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆ, ಜೇನುಸಾಕಾಣಿಕೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಗಾರ, ಎರೆಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ಗೋಬರ್ ಗ್ಯಾಸ್, ಜಾನುವಾರು ಆರೈಕೆ, ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಫಿ ತೋಟದ ನಡಿಗೆ. ಕಾಂತರಾಜು ಮತ್ತು ಅವರ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಆತಿಥ್ಯ, ಮನೆಯೂಟ ಮತ್ತು ತೋಟದ ಕಾಫಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ.
